purpose: Retrospective engineering validation, not strategy selection or prospective economic validation
frozen_policy: burst receipt+1s; persistence receipt+3s; hold15s plus1s exit delivery; original controls and1s maximum mark age unchanged

two_distinct_gates.arithmetic: Raw prior canonical curve state plus raw instruction arguments plus separately decoded mint/fee configuration predict realized amounts, four post reserves, protocol/creator fees. Finalized full-block predecessor bracket and cash/token deltas independently check the reconstruction. Never infer pre-state by subtracting the tested event amounts.
two_distinct_gates.causal: Every input must be available by the decision/entry/exit boundary. Native decode clocks and later RPC response/reference clocks remain distinct. Layout presence and a recent timestamp alone do not certify write/fork/config continuity. Unknown remains unresolved.

supported_arithmetic_scope.curve: incomplete, non-Mayhem, non-cashback, non-holder-reward, depth0; no configurable creator fee
supported_arithmetic_scope.mint: Legacy SPL or Token2022 with no transfer fee and no unsupported transfer-affecting extensions
supported_arithmetic_scope.exclusions: v3, partial fills, non-SOL, changed supply, special fee modes, transfer-fee execution and unknown layouts remain unresolved, not failed orders
supported_arithmetic_scope.size_fixtures: 0.1/0.5/1 SOL are nonlinear mathematical scenarios; do not imply actual executions at those sizes

reference_selection: up to3 signature-hash-ranked same-slot independently decodable predecessor brackets per instruction variant; no arithmetic agreement or return filter; all failures retained
instruction_comparison: Preserve program/accounts/raw args/outer index/inner index/inner stack height. Normalize only top-level missing depth versus1 and non-economic UI float/string formatting.
immutable_results: Output must be a new directory; pin inputs and verify unchanged after replay. Preserve original boundaries, attempts, controls and policy admission.

sources.limit: Pinned public layouts are not proof that every deployed program version implements every semantic assumption. Real transactions validate the reported narrow scope.

sources.scope: Transfer-fee layout, ceiling/cap calculation, older/newer epoch selection; tested arithmetic only, not on-chain transfer-fee route certification
